messages:
elaine: Postmortem follow-up: observed repeated KV cache spikes causing intermittent OOMs on our small GPU pool. We need a short, actionable playbook update: triage checklist, exact commands, automation suggestion (scheduled eviction), and clear pager escalation steps. Who can own?
mike: I can own the automation PR for scheduled eviction. Suggest cronjob on the service namespace: `0 3 * * 2 /opt/tools/evict_kv.sh --targets model-A,model-B` and a dry-run flag for canaries. Also add alert suppression during the run. ETA: 3 days.
devon: I'll draft the triage checklist and exact commands to copy into the runbook. Quick list: 1) `kubectl -n serving get pods -o wide`; 2) `kubectl top pod PODNAME`; 3) `kubectl logs POD -c runtime --tail=200`; 4) `curl -sf http://$POD:8000/metrics | jq '.kv_cache_size'` and 5) eviction: `./tools/evict_kv_prefix.sh --prefix=model-A --confirm`. Include expected ranges.
pagerbot: Incident recorded 2026-05-12T09:34Z. Playbook link: <https://internal.runbooks/redwood/kv-cache-spike>. Reminder: tag with `runbook:update`.
arjun: Escalation refinement: if kv_cache_size > 90% for 5m -> page capacity-oncall and @arjun; if >95% for 10m -> escalate to infra-leads + open capacity-surge ticket. Page should include minimal context: last 3 kubectl top outputs, eviction script output (or dry-run), and `ps aux` snapshot.
elaine: Good. Add a short fallback routing step: `rbctl route adjust --model model-A --weight 0.1` with an explicit rollback command and reason field to include in the page. Keep fallback as last-resort with approval from capacity-oncall.
mike: For validation after automation, add a smoke check job that runs 5m after eviction and asserts kv_cache_size < 70% and latency within baseline. Add a Github Actions job that notifies #incidents on failures.
devon: I'll include troubleshooting bullets: if eviction returns EBUSY -> collect dmesg + check kernel OOM logs, then perform graceful restart: `systemctl restart redwood-runtime` (for on-prem) or `kubectl rollout restart deployment/serving-runtime` for k8s. Also include command to capture per-process memory: `pmap -x PID | sort -k3 -n | tail -n 10`.
elaine: Owners and deadlines: mike -> scheduled eviction automation (due 2026-05-15), devon -> runbook text + triage checklist (due 2026-05-13), arjun -> escalation matrix + pager text (due 2026-05-12). I'll open a meta-issue and link these as checklist items.
arjun: Add a recurring pattern note: spikes coincide with weekly batch scoring on Wednesdays. Suggest adjusting batch TTLs or moving heavy jobs to off-peak. Also propose an observability query: `sum by (instance) (kv_cache_size) > 0.85` -> alert.
mike: I'll include a dry-run toggle in the cron and a `--notify-channel=#incidents` flag. Will PR and tag for review.
devon: Quick PR template for runbook edits: Summary, Reasons, Commands (with expected outputs), Escalation steps, Validation, Owners+Due dates, Related incidents. Keep edits minimal and explicit so oncall can follow fast.
elaine: Thanks all. Please post PR links here when ready. I'll close the meta-issue once all checklist items are merged. :white_check_mark:
